ui.setup.title: Welcome to Unagikuma

ui.login.forgot: Forgot the password? On the server run

ui.banner.serial_not_bumped: monitors.bind was edited but its serial was not increased, so the change is not applied yet.
ui.banner.serial_lower: The serial in monitors.bind ({serial}) is lower than the running one; the change is ignored.
ui.ov.no_channels_hint: Problems are only shown here until you add a channel such as Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram or email.
ui.ov.no_default_chain: The default policy has no channels: problems are not sent anywhere.
ui.ov.value: Noise avoided in the last 7 days
ui.ov.welcome_hint: Add a website, a server port or paste a list of hosts to start.
ui.value.outage_saved: Alerts held back during local network outages
ui.value.cap_saved: Repeats stopped by the notification limit
ui.value.none: Nothing yet: no blips, outages or repeats had to be filtered.
ui.health.title: This host
ui.health.uplink.cannot_judge: Not enough internet monitors to judge
ui.health.need_anchors: add 2+ internet monitors or wan anchors
ui.path.title: Check path
ui.path.exit_hint: Display only: reaching {addr} shows this host gets out to the internet. Change it with the localnet.exit-target setting.
ui.health.hb_off: Not set: nobody notices if this host dies
ui.inc.ack_hint: Acknowledging stops repeat notifications; the recovery notice is still sent.
ui.inc.comment_ph: Who is on it, what is being done…
ui.mon.sort.name: By name
ui.mon.none_hint: Add a website, a port or a device to watch.
ui.mon.query_help: Filters: status:critical, type:udp, tag:env:prod, group:lab, depth:l1, flag:weak; prefix with - to exclude.
ui.flag.weak_hint: Only L1: a missing reply cannot prove the service is down
ui.flag.held_hint: Paused because this host's own network is down
ui.mon.delete_confirm: Delete monitor {name}? Its history is kept until it expires.
ui.mon.soft_hint: Attempt {attempt} of {max}: alerts go out only if it keeps failing.
ui.mon.name_hint: Letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore; unique
ui.mon.interval_hint: How often to check, e.g. 30s, 1m, 5m. Empty uses the default.
ui.mon.options_hint: Extra key=value options of this check type; start typing to see suggestions.
ui.mon.type_hint.HTTP: Requests a URL and checks the status code, optionally a keyword or JSON value, and the certificate.
ui.mon.type_hint.TCP: Connects to a port; can send a string and expect a reply, or check TLS.
ui.mon.type_hint.PING: ICMP echo; reports loss and round-trip time.
ui.mon.type_hint.UDP: Speaks the real protocol of well-known UDP services (DNS, NTP, SNMP, …) by keyword, or a raw payload.
ui.mon.type_hint.DNS: Asks a DNS server for a name and checks the answer.
ui.mon.type_hint.NTP: Asks a time server and checks that it answers and its offset.
ui.mon.type_hint.SNMP: Reads an OID with SNMP v1/v2c (v3 discovery without credentials).
ui.mon.type_hint.SYSLOG: Sends a syslog test message (UDP cannot confirm delivery: weak check).
ui.mon.type_hint.PUSH: Waits for your job to call a URL; alerts when it stops calling.
ui.mon.target_hint.DNS: DNS server to ask; set query=name
ui.mon.target_hint.SNMP: Device address; set community and oid
ui.quick.hint: One target per line: a URL, host:port, host, or “udp host:keyword”. Names are derived automatically.
ui.chart.empty: No latency data in this range yet.
ui.push.title: Push URL
ui.push.hint: Call this URL from your job or cron when it succeeds. Missing calls raise an alert.
ui.push.rotate_confirm: Create a new URL? The current one stops working immediately.
ui.push.rotated: A new push URL was created
ui.config.conflict: Someone changed the configuration meanwhile. Reload and redo your edit.
ui.config.help: Lines are “name [interval] IN TYPE target key=value…”. Changes are applied as soon as they are saved.
ui.config.rollback_confirm: Restore version {serial}? It is applied as a new version.
ui.config.diff_title: Version {serial} compared with the running one
ui.ch.intro: Channels are where notifications go. Policies decide which channels are used and how often.
ui.ch.none_hint: Add Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Slack, Discord, email or any webhook.
ui.ch.secret_hint: Stored encrypted; monitors.bind only gets a ${secret:…} reference.
ui.pol.chain_hint: In order: with “fallback” the next one is used only when the previous fails.
ui.pol.repeat_hint: While still failing and not acknowledged
ui.pol.reopen_hint: A new failure within this time continues the old incident
ui.pol.intro: A policy turns an incident into notifications: which channels, how many and how often.
ui.pol.predict_hint: Shows which notifications a monitor would send if it failed now and stayed down for the given minutes.
ui.set.instance_hint: Shown in notifications; default is the host name
ui.set.message_lang_hint: Language of notifications and system messages
ui.set.heartbeat_hint: Unagikuma calls this URL every minute. A service like healthchecks.io alerts you when the calls stop, so you also learn when this host itself is down.
ui.tun.intro: Every threshold Unagikuma uses can be changed here. Values are stored as $SET lines in monitors.bind.
ui.tok.intro: Tokens let scripts and other tools use the API: send them as “Authorization: Bearer nk_…”.
ui.tok.created: Copy the token now; it is not shown again.
ui.tok.delete_confirm: Revoke token {name}? Tools using it stop working.
ui.scope.ack_hint: Read, plus acknowledge, silence and check now
ui.scope.write_hint: Acknowledge, plus change monitors and configuration
ui.scope.admin_hint: Everything, including tokens, secrets and backups
ui.sec.intro: Secrets are stored encrypted in the database. Use them in monitors.bind as
ui.sec.delete_confirm: Delete secret {name}? Monitors or channels using it will fail.
ui.kw.intro: Keywords Unagikuma understands in UDP targets (host:keyword). The depth says how much a healthy reply proves.
ui.kw.reflective_hint: Can be abused for amplification attacks; only probe your own devices (authorized=yes)
ui.sys.backup_hint: Archive of the databases and monitors.bind. Restore with unagikuma restore.
ui.acc.changed: Password changed; other sessions were signed out
ui.pub.not_found: This status page does not exist.
ui.pub.stale: Could not refresh; showing the last known state.
ui.mon.no_incidents: No incidents recorded for this monitor.
reason.all_abstain: No node could judge this check
ui.node.intro_single: This server checks everything by itself, which is a complete setup. Add a node to check the same targets from another office or data center: alerts are then decided by a vote of the nodes, and a failure seen from one place only stays a quiet regional note.
ui.node.intro: Nodes check the same targets from other places. Each round is decided by a vote; a failure seen from some nodes only is shown as partial.
ui.node.name_hint: Short name used in monitors.bind, e.g. bj
ui.node.title: Description
ui.node.new_token_confirm: Issue a new token for {node}? The current one stops working and the agent needs the new one.
ui.node.revoke_confirm: Revoke the token of {node}? Its agent is disconnected and cannot come back until it gets a new token.
ui.node.delete_confirm: Remove node {node} from monitors.bind and revoke its token?
ui.node.token_once: The token is shown only now; the master keeps only its hash. Run one of these commands on the node.
ui.node.server_hint: How the node reaches this server's port. Agents need the port itself, not an HTTP reverse proxy.
sys.maint_start: Maintenance started: {title}, until {end} ({n} monitors, not notified)
ui.sys.backup_pass_hint: With a passphrase the archive is encrypted and also holds unagikuma.key and the cluster CA, so secrets and agents keep working after a restore. Without one, keep unagikuma.key separately.
ui.sys.backup_pass_short: The passphrase needs at least 8 characters
ui.join.code_intro: One-time code for adding a server as a node. Paste it under Settings › Nodes › Join cluster on that server.
ui.join.clear_confirm: Delete the {n} local monitors and join?
ui.join.imported: {n} monitors imported to the master, paused, in section {node}.
ui.join.intro: Make this server a node of a cluster. The master assigns its checks.
ui.join.import_hint: Added to section <node> on the master, disabled until resumed.
ui.join.leave_confirm: Leave the cluster of {master}? Checks stop; remove the node on the master as well.
ui.node.anchors_hint: Self-check targets: lan:IP,IP;wan:IP. Empty = default gateway; none = off.
sys.agent_master_down: Node {node} cannot reach master {master} for {duration}: nothing is being monitored or notified from there
ui.user.intro: Accounts and their rights. An operator can be limited to some $SCOPE sections.
ui.user.areas_hint: $SCOPE specs, comma separated (region:north, bj). Empty = all sections and shared configuration.
ui.user.delete_confirm: Delete user {name} and its API tokens?
ui.user.role.admin_hint: everything, including users, nodes and backups
ui.import.intro: Uptime Kuma data: kuma.db (stop Uptime Kuma first) or a JSON backup from version 1. Monitors, the channels they use, matching policies and accounts are added; credentials go to secrets, passwords keep working. Monitors that exist here already are skipped.
sys.report_title: Daily status: {down} of {hosts} hosts down, {bad} of {services} services not OK
sys.report_title_ok: Daily status: all {hosts} hosts UP, all {services} services OK
ui.report.intro: Sent daily at {at} through policy {policy}: hosts DOWN and UP, services not OK. Preview of the current state:
ui.mon.type_hint.EXEC: Runs a script from the node's check-scripts directory, Nagios plugin conventions: exit 0 OK, 1 WARNING (degraded), 2 CRITICAL, 3 UNKNOWN; perfdata becomes metrics. New script checks start paused. Administrators only.
ui.mon.target_hint.EXEC: Plugin file name and arguments; or arguments in args=. $HOSTADDRESS$ is replaced by address=.
ui.import.area_hint: $SCOPE section for the monitors, e.g. region:north. Empty = global.
ui.import.manager_hint: Existing account put in charge of the section.
ui.import.role_hint: Operators and viewers are limited to the section.
ui.audit.intro: Every change to accounts, permissions, secrets, nodes and configuration: who, what, in which section, from where. Failed logins included. Kept for retention.audit.
ui.reg.intro: Monitoring, alerting and every check work without registration. A licence adds the registered-only features. Send the installation number below to get a trial licence.
ui.reg.import_hint: Choose license.json or paste its contents. An invalid licence is refused and the current one kept.
ui.reg.remove_confirm: Remove the licence? Registered-only features stop; nothing else changes.
ui.audit.locked: The audit log needs a registered installation
ui.audit.locked_hint: Changes are being recorded already; register to read them, including everything recorded before registration.
ui.scripts.badge: {n} script checks cannot run on some node
ui.scripts.enable_confirm: {plugin} is missing or not executable on: {nodes}. Enable anyway? Those nodes will not take part in the check.
ui.scripts.intro: Scripts are copied to each node by its administrator; each node reports what is in its check-script directory:
ui.scripts.problems: {n} enabled script checks cannot run on some node: copy the script there, or pause the check.
ui.scripts.empty_dir: No scripts in this node's directory.
ui.ha.handover_confirm: Hand the master role to {node} ({addr})? It takes the current state and restarts as master; this server stops checking and refuses changes. Nodes move over by themselves.
ui.ha.standby_hint: The https://host:port this node serves on. It then keeps a copy of the master's state and can take over.
ui.ha.promote_confirm: Make this server the master with its copy of the state? Do this only when the master at {master} is down for good or is being replaced. This server restarts.
ui.ha.promote_hint: When the master is gone for good, this server can take over with its copy of the master's state.
ui.ha.promoting: Taking over (term {term}); the page reconnects after the restart
ui.ha.superseded: This server is no longer the master: term {term} went to {by} on {at}. It no longer checks or notifies; change the configuration on the new master.
ui.top.saved: {n} useless alerts held back this week
ui.ov.path_hint: Each line is a probe node's way to the targets · live
ui.story.local: This host's network is down, not {n} targets
ui.story.local_text: Affected checks are held and not counted in availability. When the network is back you get one summary instead of one alert per target.
ui.story.node_down: {node}'s own internet is down, not {n} internet targets
ui.story.node_down_text: Its votes on internet monitors turn into abstentions; the other nodes judge as usual.
ui.story.crit_text: The network paths are fine, so these are the targets themselves.
ui.story.partial: {n} monitors fail from some nodes only
ui.story.partial_text: A failure seen by a minority of nodes does not alert. If it lasts it becomes one low-priority regional alert, sent once.
ui.story.slow_text: They answer above the slow threshold; slow is not counted as down.
ui.story.ok_cluster: {n} nodes online, every path is normal
ui.story.ok_cluster_text: Each target is checked from several nodes and fails only when most of them fail; a node's own trouble never becomes an alert.
ui.story.ok_single: This host's network is fine and every monitor is checked on time
ui.story.ok_single_text: Gateway {gateway} answers in {rtt}; DNS is fine.
ui.ov.matrix_none: No monitor is checked by several nodes yet.
ui.ov.matrix_same: All nodes agree; here are some live votes.
ui.drawer.formula: {fail} failed · {ok} OK · {healthy}/{n} healthy nodes · {q} failures needed →
ev.ack_cleared: acknowledgement cleared: the failure reason changed
ev.closed_redefined: incident closed: the monitor was redefined
ev.closed_deleted: incident closed: the monitor was deleted
ev.incident_capped: notification limit reached: no more reminders
ev.no_channels: not notified: policy {policy} has no channels
ev.degraded_superseded: slow-response incident closed: the monitor failed
ui.pal.help_add: Type an address to add it: https://…, 10.1.1.1:443, 10.1.1.1:ntp
ui.pal.help_kw: After host: type ? to list the UDP keywords
ui.pal.help_ack: ack NAME acknowledges, check NAME checks now
ui.pal.help_silence: silence NAME 1h silences (m, h or d)
ui.ob.title: Get started
ui.ob.s1_hint: One per line: a URL, host:port, host:keyword or ping host.
ui.ob.s2_hint: Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Slack, email or a webhook — then send a test message.
ui.ob.s3_hint: Put the channel in the default policy so problems reach you.
ui.why.title: Notifications
ui.why.paused: Paused: not checked and not notified.
ui.why.maint: In a maintenance window: failures are not notified and not counted.
ui.why.parent: Its parent {parent} is down: only the parent alerts.
ui.why.local: This host's own network is down: judgement is held, and you get one summary instead of an alert per target.
ui.why.unknown: Cannot be judged ({reason}): not counted as a failure.
ui.why.partial: Only some nodes fail ({quorum}): no alert. If it lasts it becomes one low-priority regional alert.
ui.why.slow: Slow is not down: no failure alert.
ui.why.soft: Soft state {attempt}/{max}: it alerts after {max} failures in a row.
ui.why.acked: Acknowledged by {who}: no more reminders; you still hear when it recovers.
ui.why.capped: Notification limit of {max} reached: no more reminders.
ui.why.no_channels: Not notified: policy {policy} has no channels.
ui.why.queued: The notification is queued or delayed by the policy.
ui.mon.type_hint.REDIS: Logs in when password= is given and expects PONG; role=master or replica checks replication.
ui.mon.type_hint.POSTGRES: Logs in with user= and password= (md5 or SCRAM) and runs SELECT 1; without credentials, proves the server answers. ssl=yes for SSL.
ui.mon.type_hint.MYSQL: Logs in with user= and password= and sends a ping; without credentials, reads the server greeting. ssl=yes for SSL.
ui.mon.type_hint.GRPC: Calls the standard gRPC health check (grpc.health.v1) and expects SERVING; service= asks about one service, tls=yes for TLS.
ui.mon.type_hint.DOCKER: Checks a container on each probing node through its Docker socket: running, and healthy if it has a health check.
ui.ch.period_hint: Only send inside this time period (PERIOD record); !name sends only outside it.
ui.ch.members_hint: Channel names, comma separated; all of them are notified at once.
ui.import.nagios_intro: Choose the Nagios object files (hosts, services, commands, contacts, time periods; several at once). Templates are resolved; plugins without a built-in equivalent become EXEC checks that need the plugin in the check-scripts directory.
ui.pub.link_invalid: This link is no longer valid.
ui.notice.intro: Announcements appear on the public status page; subscribers can be e-mailed. Status pages are STATUSPAGE records in monitors.bind (domain= for an own host name, subscribe=CHANNEL for e-mail subscriptions).
ui.notice.title: Title
ui.notice.no_pages_hint: Add a STATUSPAGE record to monitors.bind, e.g. public IN STATUSPAGE "Service status" select="tag:public".
ui.import.user.quota: not added: the licence's account limit is reached
ui.reg.over_quota: over the licence: nothing is switched off, but no more can be added
ui.err.record_changed: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.
ui.uptime.coverage: Watched for only {pct} of this window so far: too little for an uptime figure.
ui.node.needs_upgrade: Too old for {n} checks: upgrade it
ui.dir.intro: Everyone who may receive alerts. Channels send only to addresses listed here: people who left and addresses that keep bouncing are skipped, unknown addresses get a red dot.
ui.dir.name: Name
ui.dir.handle_hint: Use it as @handle in a channel instead of typing the address.
ui.dir.username_hint: When the person leaves, this login is disabled too.
ui.dir.left_confirm: {name} left? Nothing will be sent to their addresses any more and their login stops working.
ui.dir.none_hint: Add the people who receive alerts, or import the addresses your channels already use.
ui.dir.unknown_banner: Addresses used by channels but not in the directory: {n}
ui.dir.bounce_rule: An address refused as nonexistent {n} times is no longer sent to.
ui.dir.bounce_off: Bounced addresses are still sent to (contacts.bounce-threshold is 0).
ui.dir.clear_hint: Fixed it? Clear the count and send to it again.
ui.dir.new_intro: These addresses are not in the contact directory. Add them, so they are kept up to date when people leave?
ui.dir.nav_dot: Some channels have recipients to check: {n}
ui.dir.issue.unknown_handle: {address} is not in the directory: nothing is sent for it
ui.dir.issue.bouncing: {address} was refused as nonexistent {n} times: skipped
ui.dir.issue.no_address: {person} has no address of this kind
ui.dir.issue.unknown_address: {address} is not in the directory: check it
ui.chg.intro: Announce planned work: the people concerned are told, reminded before it starts and told how it ended; the monitors it touches are in maintenance during the window.
ui.chg.title: Title
ui.chg.select_hint: Monitor filter (group:, tag:, name:…); they are held in maintenance during the window.
ui.chg.notify_resched: Tell them about the new time
ui.chg.note_hint: Shown in the receipt: what was done, what to watch.
ui.chg.templates_hint: Go templates: {{.Title}}, {{.Start}}, {{.End}}, {{.Duration}}, {{.Impact}}, {{.Description}}, {{.Monitors}}, {{.In}}, {{.Note}}, {{.By}}, {{.Now}}. Empty restores the built-in text.
ui.chg.none_hint: Announce planned work so the people concerned know before it happens.
ui.mon.type_hint.DOMAIN: Watches when the domain's registration expires (RDAP, or WHOIS where there is none): degraded inside days= (30), failing inside critical-days= (7). Checked every 6 hours.
ui.exp.title: Expiry dates
ui.exp.intro: Every TLS certificate and domain registration the checks watch, soonest first.
ui.exp.none_hint: HTTP and TLS checks report their certificates; a DOMAIN check watches a domain's registration.
ui.ob.s4_hint: Put every e-mail address and phone number in the contact directory, so people who leave stop getting alerts.
ui.ob.s5_hint: Show customers and colleagues what works, and post maintenance notices.
ui.notice.page_select_hint: A monitor filter: group:public shows the monitors with group=public; type:HTTP all web checks.
ui.mon.host_hint: Name or IP address, without a port.
ui.mon.port_required: Required: the port to connect to.
ui.mon.dns_query_hint: Optional. Empty only checks that the server answers; with a name, the answer is checked too.
ui.mon.dns_qtype_hint: Enter a name to look up first.
ui.mon.dns_expect_hint: Optional: an address or value the answer must contain, e.g. 203.0.113.10.
ui.mon.group_hint: Pick an existing group ({groups}) or type a new name to create one.
ui.mon.group_hint_none: Type a name to create a group; monitors with the same group are shown together.
ui.ov.exit_idle: not checked: every internet target answers
ui.config.readonly: Read-only. Add and change monitors, channels and the rest on their pages; to edit the file itself, change it on the server and raise the serial — it is applied within seconds.
ui.config.help_readonly: Each line is “name [interval] IN TYPE target key=value…”; the full syntax is in docs/spec/monitors-bind.md.
ui.cfgissue.title: Setup problems
ui.cfgissue.no_channel: No notification channel yet: when something breaks, nobody is told.
ui.cfgissue.no_policy: The default policy has no channels, so incidents notify nobody.
ui.cfgissue.contacts: Recipient problems in channels: {n} (not in the contacts, left, or bouncing).
ui.set.exit_hint: Pinged only when an internet target fails, to tell whether this host can reach the internet. Default {addr}; empty turns it off.
ui.mon.select_first: Tick monitors in the list first
ui.oc.intro: A rotation notifies only whoever is on call; the others are tried in turn only if that person cannot be reached. Put the rotation in a policy's chain to page it.
ui.oc.none_hint: Pick the channels of the people who take turns (one channel per person, such as their SMS or chat), how often they hand over, and when.
ui.oc.name: Name
ui.oc.members_hint: Tick one channel per person; the order you tick is the order of the shifts.
ui.oc.no_channels: Add a channel for each person first (Alerting › Channels).
ui.oc.start_hint: The first ticked member is on call from this date.
ui.oc.unused: No policy pages this rotation yet: add it to a policy's chain, or alerts never reach it.
ui.oc.standin_intro: Someone covers for a while: alerts go to them first, the order of the shifts stays as it is.
ui.oc.note_ph: e.g. swapped with Wang for the holiday
ui.oc.stats_hint: Each incident counts for whoever was on call when it opened. Drills and this host's own outages are left out.
sys.outage_summary_ok: This host lost its network {from}–{to} ({duration}) and could not check anything meanwhile ({paused} monitors waited). Re-checked since: all fine.
sys.outage_summary_failing: This host lost its network {from}–{to} ({duration}) and could not check anything meanwhile ({paused} monitors waited). Re-checked since: {failing} still failing — {names}
ev.outage_summary: Local outage over ({duration_s}s): {affected} monitors affected, {failing} still failing after the re-check, {dropped} stale notices dropped
ev.outage_backdated: {monitors} failures began with the local outage and were taken back
ev.closed_local_network: Incident withdrawn: it began with this host's network outage
sys.digest_network_title: Network fault: {n} monitors affected — please contact the network team
sys.digest_segment: {n} monitors in {segment} fail at the network level at the same time: the segment, its switch or its uplink is the likely cause; the services may be fine.
sys.digest_dns: {n} monitors cannot resolve their names at the same time: DNS is the likely cause; the services may be fine.
ui.pol.network_hint: Optional: channels that get the summaries blaming the network (a segment, DNS) instead of the chain, e.g. netadmin.
sys.storage_failing: Writing to the data directory fails since {time} ({error}); check results and events are kept in memory and retried, {lost} were lost. Free some disk space or fix the file system.
ui.storage_failing: Results and events cannot be written to disk since {since} (full disk?). They are kept in memory and retried; {lost} were lost.
